title: Verified Changes discovery document (/.well-known/changes.json)
description: Published at https://<site>/.well-known/changes.json: which areas a site tracks, how often, and where the changes are served. Specification: https://databutler.dev/protocol.

filtering.description: 0.2, optional: client means the JSON endpoint ignores ?since= and ?area= and consumers filter (default server).

sinceHint.description: 0.2, optional: the recommended first since (normally coverageStart − 1 day); since is strictly after.

updated.description: When this discovery document last changed.

coverageStart.description: Changes before this day are not itemised.

name.description: The value entries carry in their area field.

cadence.description: How often the sources are re-checked, in plain words.

html.description: Human-readable page of the same entries.

schema.description: JSON Schema the changes document validates against.

specification.description: Where the protocol version is specified.

licence.description: Terms the changes may be reused under.

contact.description: Where to report a wrong entry: an https: or mailto: URL.
